description: This file defines a Debug class for performance logging and profiling, including methods for timing, averaging, and interval-based logging. It also extends the global Window interface to include a debug object.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A class providing static methods and properties for performance debugging, including timing, averaging, and interval-based logging.

methods.name: logTime
methods.description: Logs the time taken for an operation, updating aggregate timing data.

methods.name: logTimeAverage
methods.description: Logs the time for an operation to compute an average over multiple runs.

methods.name: logTimeWrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that times another function and logs its duration.

methods.name: logTimeAverageWrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that times another function and logs its average duration.

methods.name: perfWrap
methods.description: Wraps a function with console timing for performance measurement.
